title: list_documents input
description: The documentation list across the portfolio: every required document of the registered applications in scope with its state (missing is computed from configuration, never stored), and every other document link on them. Writes nothing.

state.description: Which documents to list. The counts cover every state.

documentLinkId.description: Only this document link (a document's record page), on its application, whatever the application's registration.

portfolioId.description: Only the applications in this portfolio, child portfolios included.

mineOnly.description: True keeps the documents you own, and the missing documents of applications you own.
